req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI documentation with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) on /docs returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — exact status code 200 (not 201, not 199) and exact Content-Type header containing 'text/html'; (4) DT decision-table — verifying the response body contains specific Swagger UI identifiers ('swagger-ui', 'openapi') to catch mutations that serve wrong content. Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions (catches 200->201 mutations), exact string presence in body (catches content mutations), exact Content-Type check (catches header mutations).

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html
actions: Send GET /docs to the in-process TestClient
trace: R-PLAYER-018: GET /docs shall return HTTP 2xx with Swagger UI payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert 'swagger-ui' in body.lower() or 'SwaggerUI' in body or 'swagger' in body.lower()
    content_type = response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in content_type

test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_body_contains_openapi_and_swagger_identifiers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert len(body) > 0
    body_lower = body.lower()
    assert 'openapi' in body_lower or 'swagger' in body_lower

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_nonexistent_path_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs-nonexistent')
    assert response.status_code == 404
    assert response.status_code != 200
    r2 = client.get('/doc')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.status_code != 200

actions: Assert Content-Type header starts with 'text/html' (not 'application/json' or other)
trace: R-PLAYER-018: Swagger UI must be HTML, not JSON — boundary between HTML and JSON content types
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_response_content_type_is_text_html_exactly():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert content_type.startswith('text/html')
    assert 'application/json' not in content_type
    assert len(response.text) > 100
